description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveAclResponse, which represents the response to a 'RetrieveAcl' command in a Thing management API. It includes factory methods for creating instances from JSON and other parameters, as well as methods for JSON serialization, equality, and string representation. The class encapsulates details about the Thing ID and its associated Access Control List (ACL).
